subject: Finova renewal: compliance checkpoint, retention policy & capacity commitment
messages:
From: Adele Morris <adele.morris@finova.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Jan 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Upcoming renewal + SOC 2 recheck questions

Hi Stephanie,

Hope you're well — our renewal for Redwood services comes up at the end of Feb and procurement asked we kick off the security re-attestation conversation now. A couple of quick items from our side:

- Can you confirm the default audit log retention window and whether we can extend to 18 months?
- We need a one-page list of the SOC 2 evidence artifacts you can provide (logs, access reports, user activity) and whether Redwood will assist with bulk evidence upload.
- We're also evaluating an increase in committed capacity (burst and seat uplift). If we increase commitment by ~30% what flexibility do we have on pricing/term?

Would appreciate a short call this week to align. Copying Ben from Redwood since he handled our last evidence handoff.

Thanks,
Adele
Adele Morris
Head of IT Compliance
Finova Systems
From: stephanie_nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: Adele Morris <adele.morris@finova.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 10 Jan 2028 10:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Upcoming renewal + SOC 2 recheck questions

Hi Adele — thanks for the heads up and the clear summary. Happy to run this through and set expectations. Quick answers up front, full details below and attached (SOC2-Evidence-Checklist.xlsx):

- Retention: default audit log retention is 12 months; we can extend to 18 months for platform logs as an addendum. Options attached (Retention-Options.pdf).
- Evidence bundle: we provide system access logs, admin action traces, key config snapshots, and sampling of request/response traces. We can assist with bulk evidence ingestion (we offer an evidence-upload runbook and a managed handoff option).
- Capacity/term: increasing committed capacity by 30% can be structured either as a 12-month seat uplift (pro-rated for the remainder of the term) or a 24-month renewed commitment with a blended discount. I can put numbers together after the call.

Proposed next steps:
1) 30-minute compliance sync this Thursday 1/12 at 10:00am PT?
2) If that works, we'll share the evidence checklist and a draft amendment (DocuSign) for procurement to preview.

Attaching SOC2-Evidence-Checklist.xlsx (summary) for your review.

—
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0192
From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 11 Jan 2028 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: Finova renewal — resource ask and pricing play

Stephanie — quick internal note before the call with Finova.

- We can support the 18-month retention via a term amendment; storage and retrieval cost delta is roughly 12–15% depending on ingest volume (we should confirm Finova's projected log volume).
- For evidence assistance: Marissa can run the bulk upload + verification (small SOW, 2–3 days of engineering support for the initial handoff).
- Pricing: if they commit +30% capacity, propose: 10% off list for 12-month addendum, 18% off for 24-month renewal (we can flex up to 20% with executive sign-off).

I'll draft an amendment template and a brief SOW (Marissa — can you prepare the managed upload estimate and estimated engineering days?).

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Adele Morris <adele.morris@finova.com>
To: stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@finova.com
Date: Thu, 12 Jan 2028 14:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Upcoming renewal + SOC 2 recheck questions

Thanks Stephanie — Thursday works, confirmed. A couple of clarifications for the call so we can come prepared:

- Retention: 18 months is preferred for audit purposes. If there is a cost delta, procurement will want an explicit line item and the impact on our monthly overage rates.
- Evidence: we would like Redwood to help with the initial bulk upload and to validate sampling results. Please confirm whether the upload requires any special formatting and whether you accept CSV exports from our SIEM.
- Key mgmt / logs: we need confirmation that audit logs for admin activity are available as part of the evidence bundle, and whether logs include AWS KMS key ids (or whether that is blocked).

Procurement looped in; they asked for a DocuSign preview of the amendment and a short bullets-only summary to attach to their internal approval memo.

See you on the call.

Adele
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Adele Morris <adele.morris@finova.com>, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 13 Jan 2028 09:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Upcoming renewal + SOC 2 recheck questions — answers and artifacts

Hi Adele — follow-up with the specifics we discussed on the call this morning. Attaching: Retention-Options.pdf and Audit-Access-Guide.pdf (attachment stubs).

Summary answers:
- Retention: We support 12 / 18 / 24 month retention windows for platform audit logs. 18 months is available as a contractual amendment; projected storage cost is +13% on top of base bill for typical Finova log ingestion (we ran a sample off your January export). Line item will be explicit in the amendment.
- Evidence upload: We accept CSV exports from your SIEM. Preferred columns and sample mapping are in the Audit-Access-Guide.pdf. Our managed upload package includes: initial validation, sampling (we sample 5% of ingested records for parity checks), and a verification memo. Estimated effort: 2 engineer-days plus 1 account operations day. SOW stub attached.
- Admin logs & KMS: Admin activity logs are included. For KMS metadata: we ingest KMS identifiers (key ids) but we do not receive customer-managed HSM key material. If you have customer-managed keys in KMS, we can include the key id in the evidence bundle; we do not surface key material.

DocuSign preview: https://www.docusign.com/IN/ABCDEF-12345 (preview link). We'll prepare a short bullets-only summary for procurement and attach the amendment.

Questions for you so we can finalize:
1) Desired retention window (please confirm 18 months).
2) Target committed capacity after uplift (please confirm percent or absolute units so we can run pricing).

—
Marissa Cole
Senior Product Ops, Security Enablement
Redwood Inference
From: Adele Morris <adele.morris@finova.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@finova.com
Date: Tue, 18 Jan 2028 16:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Upcoming renewal + SOC 2 recheck questions — answers and artifacts

Marissa / Stephanie — thanks for the thorough answers and the attachments. Procurement has reviewed the DocuSign preview and asked for one small change (clarify the start date for the retention amendment to align with our fiscal cycle). Otherwise they are ready to proceed.

Final confirmations:
- Retention: we confirm 18 months.
- Capacity: we will increase committed capacity by 30% as an addendum for the remaining 12 months of our current agreement. Procurement will sign the amendment once the start date language is adjusted.

I attached the signed procurement intent memo (stub: Finova-Amendment-signed.pdf). Please send the revised DocuSign and a short billing impact line item for our finance team.

Best,
Adele
Adele Morris
Head of IT Compliance
Finova Systems
